title: About Us: Visuals for Small Online Shops | AIVideosUGC
description: Learn about AIVideosUGC, the online tool that helps small shops turn one product photo into short video ads and store images, with private uploads. Read on.
h1: About AIVideosUGC: Product Visuals Made Simple
lead: Here's what AIVideosUGC is about: tools that help online sellers make product photos and short video ads from a single picture, so less time goes into shoots and more into running the store.
secondary_keywords: product content tool for Etsy shops

paras: AIVideosUGC is an online tool for turning a product photo into new store images and short video ads. You upload a picture of what you sell, pick a template or write what you'd like to see, and get back a square image or a short video of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

We keep the tools focused on things sellers use every week: white background shots, lifestyle scenes, on-model photos, feed ad images and short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

We build for small and growing online stores on Shopify, Amazon and Etsy, and for the marketers who run their ads. If you pack orders, write listings and set up campaigns yourself, you're exactly who we have in mind.
You don't need design software or ad expertise. A clear photo of your product and a sentence about the scene you picture are enough to get started.
Everything you upload and everything you make stays in your own account. We don't make your product photos or results public.
Some requests are turned down, such as ones involving celebrities, other public figures, or logos and trademarks that belong to someone else. That keeps the focus on your own products.
Every photo and video shows its price in credits up front. Credits are reserved when a job begins, charged only when the result arrives, and returned automatically if something goes wrong.
Delivered results are generally not refunded, so we put the cost on screen before you commit rather than after.

faq.q: Can I make product ads without hiring an agency?
faq.a: Yes. AIVideosUGC is a self-serve tool: upload your product photo or describe the scene, review the result, and download the asset from your account.

faq.q: How do I get in touch with the AIVideosUGC team?
faq.a: Write to support@aivideosugc.com with your question. We try to respond within two business days.

faq.q: What can I upload to make a product asset?
faq.a: Upload a product photo you own or describe the product and scene. Review the result against the real item before you download or publish it.
It is a self-serve tool for online sellers who need product photos and short ad videos from their own product images or descriptions.
